full_judgment:
Md. Abdul Matin J.:- This petition for leave to appeal is directed against the judgment and order dated 10.11.2008 passed by the High Court Division in First Appeal No. 109 of 2007 preferred against judgment and decree dated 11.03.2007 passed by learned Joint District Judge, 5th Court, Dhaka in Title Suit No. 176 of 2006 rejecting the plaint on an application filed under Order 7 Rule 11 read with Section 151 of the Code of Civil Procedure. 

 2. The facts, in short, are that the plaintiff appellant respondents filed the suit for recovery of TK. 15,48,95,233.69. The claim in the suit arose in consequence of bifurcation of various shareholder-directors of a member of company comprising of Meghna Group of Industries regrouped into "ka" and "kha" group and interchanging amongst themselves the share holder-Directors in bifurcated la' group and 'kha' group. All the enterprises of Meghna Group of Industries are loanees of Sonali Bank Ltd. In consequence of bifurcation and interchanging of positions of share holder-Directors, shares were transferred to give effect to the new arrangement with consent of Sonali Bank Ltd. The outstanding loan liability of shareholder-Directors of 'ka' group originally payable by enterprises of 'kha' group towards liquidating loan liability remained payable to Sonali Bank Ltd. The bifurcation of parties of Meghna Group of Industries took place as per agreement dated 03.11.2001 and sub-sequent amendments dated 22.01.2004 and 04.03.2004 whereby ultimately an amount of Tk.15,48,95,235.69 remained outstanding payable by 'ka' group enterprise to 'kha' group enterprise for adjustment of their loan liability payable to Sonali Bank Ltd. that the agreements referred to above were signed and executed by and between enterprises belong to 'ka' and 'kha' group of Meghna Group of Industries. The suit was filed showing 'kha' group enterprises and their Directors against Sonali Bank Ltd. Managing Director and General Manager, Sonali Bank, local office as principal defendant Nos. 1 and 2 and further including as principal defendants Nos. 3 to 6 Director-shareholders in their personal names, but including in the plaint as preform defendants Nos. 7 to 10 the companies of 'ka' group. The plaintiff-appellant-respondent in the relief sought for in the plaint prayed for a decree of declaration and alternatively a money decree against the principal defendant-respondent-petitioners Sonali Bank Ltd. in respect of Tk. 15,45,95,235.69 jointly and severally. 

 4. Being aggrieved with the judgment and order dated 11.03.2007 of rejection of plaint the plaintiff appellant-respondent filed First Appeal No. 109 of 2007 in the High Court Division and the High Court Division on hearing the parties allowed the appeal and set aside the judgment and decree dated 11.012007 passed in Title Suit No. 176 of 2006 by the learned Joint District Judge, 5th Court, Dhaka and restored the suit in its original file and number.
